fields.summary_ko.0: Samsung Electronics, KB Securities maintains $600K price target and 'buy' rating - projected to exceed cumulative operating profit of 56 years since founding through KRW 1,022 trillion operating profit over next two years (2026-2027).
fields.summary_ko.1: HBM average selling price expected to rise 150% year-over-year - global HBM market share risen to 40% in Q3, approaching DRAM market share.
fields.summary_ko.2: Next year operating profit raised to KRW 640 trillion, net profit to KRW 508 trillion - Samsung Electronics' next-year operating profit expected to rank #1 globally, surpassing NVIDIA.
